summary: New-customer signup and KYC are failing because auth-kyc cannot open TCP connections to the external KYC vendor (kyc-provider). Its logs show 'connection refused' from 09:55:40Z, matching the reported onset of about 09:55. auth-kyc err_rate reached 0.604 (last 0.603) while rps stayed flat at about 15, so the failures are not load-driven. The only change in the window is a postgres 'metrics label rename' deploy at 09:13, which is unrelated and 40 minutes before onset. I could not tell from this data whether the vendor is down or whether egress, DNS or the endpoint from our side is broken. I also did not check the onset point on the metric series or the other services' logs.

hypotheses.statement: auth-kyc cannot connect to the external KYC vendor (kyc-provider) because the vendor is down or refusing connections, which blocks KYC and signup.
hypotheses.label: medium

auth-kyc error rate is very high (max 0.604, last 0.603, min 0.002) while rps stays flat, so it is not a load surge
rps is stable, ruling out a traffic surge
